Container.Name: Odo
Container.Overview: Odo is a self-hosted fuel fill-up tracker. Take a photo of your odometer and a photo of your gas receipt and Odo turns them into a complete fill-up record using local OCR -- no cloud services, no subscriptions, no external database. Everything (SQLite database, photos, settings) lives under the single /data path so container updates/recreations never lose data.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Odo web interface

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database, uploaded photos, and settings. Back up this path to back up all of Odo.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone used for 'this month' stats and displayed timestamps, e.g. America/Chicago

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that will own files under /data (99 = nobody on Unraid)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that will own files under /data (100 = users on Unraid)
